name: gate-metrics
summary: Read-only numbers from gate verdict files (VERDICT.md) and the gate-spawns index that model-guard writes: first-gate FAIL share and spawn counts.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (verdicts under bug-gate/, index in state/gate-spawns.jsonl)
env.GATE_SPAWNS_LOG: optional index file; model-guard writes it, gate-metrics reads it
